excerpt_i18n.en: In the past three years, rapid advances in large models first took place in the digital world. Text, images, code, and video can all be converted into data; models learn the patterns within through massive pre-training, then perform understanding, reasoning, and generation. But the tasks and scenarios that the digital world can cover are ultimately limited. If AI is to further expand its industrial value, it must move from information processing into the real world—beginning to understand the environment and interact with the physical world. If this wave of AI is divided into two phases, the first half was a contest over models, while competition in the second half is increasingly shifting toward the deployment of physical AI. At this year's IFA, the largest consumer electronics and future technology expo, Leiphone.com clearly sensed that AI is moving from generating content and solving digital tasks into the physical world. The expo featured a dedicated "World of AI & Future of Tech" agenda, showcasing the latest advances in robotics, AI wearables, and smart homes, with the largest number of humanoid robots on display of any edition to date. Clearly, no company wants to miss out on physical AI—the most imaginative industrial opportunity since mobile internet. And as the first tech company in the world to achieve "full-scenario human-vehicle-home physical AI," Xiaomi unsurprisingly drew widespread attention from overseas consumers at IFA this year. As is well known, the threshold for physical AI is far higher than for model applications in the digital world, and the chain is extremely long, spanning chips, models, operating systems,
excerpt_i18n.es: Durante los últimos tres años, el rápido avance de los grandes modelos ha ocurrido primero en el mundo digital. Textos, imágenes, códigos y vídeos pueden convertirse en datos; los modelos aprenden sus patrones mediante entrenamiento masivo y luego realizan comprensión, razonamiento y generación. Sin embargo, las tareas y escenarios que el mundo digital puede cubrir son limitados. Si la IA quiere ampliar aún más su valor industrial, necesita pasar del procesamiento de información al mundo real, empezar a comprender el entorno e interactuar con el mundo físico. Si dividimos esta ola de IA en dos fases, la primera mitad se disputa por los modelos, mientras que la segunda se está orientando cada vez más hacia la implementación de la IA física. items.raw_excerpt: 9月4日，国际数据机构（IDC）发布《中国零售云市场份额，2025》 （以下简称为《报告》）。 腾讯云通过整合PaaS、SaaS及CaaS（咨询即服务）能力，形成覆盖平台、应用及AI服务的产品矩阵，以23.4%的市场份额在解决方案市场位居第一。同时，腾讯云2025年零售云收入同比增长16.8%，在头部厂商中增速最快。 报告显示，2025年中国零售云市场规模达135亿元人民币，同比增长12.4%。随着零售企业IT投入由系统建设转向业务价值驱动，PaaS、数据平台及AI服务占比持续提升，行业解决方案能力逐渐成为市场增长核心驱动力，同比增速达13.9%。 面向这一趋势，腾讯云以模型、工程与场景的综合优势，把解决方案能力变成客户现场的真实经营收益，并通过CaaS将行业洞察前置，与客户共创FDE落地新路径。 智能体加速进入真实业务场景 IDC全球研究显示，AI和Agentic AI（代理式AI）正加速融入零售PaaS和SaaS产品，推动智能导购、需求预测、自动补货、智能定价及客户运营等场景规模化落地。 在企业内部，智能体正在接管巡店、补货、客服这类高频运营动作：瑞幸咖啡、好想来正在借助腾讯云智能体开发平台，在多个场景下打造门店AI巡检算法能力；五粮液浓香酒打造了5个AI智能体，承接70%来自终端、经销商及内部员工的基础业务问询；华熙生物引入腾讯AI质检能力大幅度提升检测效率，实现缺陷秒级响应与全量追溯。 在营销与服务环节，麦当劳基于腾讯智能座舱AI Agent点餐方案，为顾客带来更便捷、轻松的消费体验；伊利打造的导购智能体和下单智能体，有效推动订单数提升26%，转化率提升39%；慕思集团通过腾讯AI原生营销云实现客户数据整合，3个月链接超1.8万潜力客户，显著提升转化效率和客单价。 CaaS 牵引，和客户共创 FDE 模式 IDC分析指出，腾讯零售云的能力特点不仅来自PaaS与Saa

excerpt_i18n.en: On September 4, international data firm IDC released the "China Retail Cloud Market Share, 2025" report. By integrating PaaS, SaaS, and CaaS (Consulting-as-a-Service) capabilities, Tencent Cloud has built a product matrix covering platforms, applications, and AI services, ranking first in the solutions market with a 23.4% market share. Meanwhile, Tencent Cloud's retail cloud revenue grew 16.8% year-over-year in 2025, the fastest among leading vendors. The report shows that China's retail cloud market reached RMB 13.5 billion in 2025, up 12.4% year-over-year. As retail enterprises shift IT investment from system building to business value-driven initiatives, the share of PaaS, data platforms, and AI services continues to rise, and industry solution capabilities are becoming the core growth driver of the market, with a year-over-year growth rate of 13.9%. In response to this trend, Tencent Cloud leverages its comprehensive strengths in models, engineering, and scenarios to turn solution capabilities into real operational gains for customers on-site, and through CaaS brings industry insights to the forefront, co-creating new paths for FDE implementation with customers. Agents are rapidly entering real business scenarios. IDC global research shows that AI and Agentic AI are accelerating integration into retail PaaS and SaaS products, driving large-scale deployment of scenarios such as intelligent shopping guidance, demand forecasting, automatic replenishment, dynamic pricing, and customer operations. Within enterprises, agents are taking over high-frequency operational tasks such as store inspections, replenishment, and customer service: Luckin Coffee and Haoxianglai are leveraging Tencent Cloud's intelligent
excerpt_i18n.es: El 4 de septiembre, la firma internacional de datos IDC publicó el informe *Cuota de mercado del retail cloud en China, 2025* (en adelante, el «Informe»). Tencent Cloud, mediante la integración de capacidades de PaaS, SaaS y CaaS (consultoría como servicio), ha conformado una matriz de productos que abarca plataformas, aplicaciones y servicios de IA, situándose en primer lugar en el mercado de soluciones con una cuota del 23,4 %. Asimismo, en 2025 los ingresos de retail cloud de Tencent Cloud crecieron un 16,8 % interanual, el ritmo más rápido entre los principales proveedores. El Informe muestra que el mercado chino de retail cloud alcanzó en 2025 un tamaño de 13 500 millones de RMB, con un aumento interanual del 12,4 %. **News Highlights**

1. OpenAI releases its most powerful model ever, GPT-6 Astra: million-token context, autonomous computer operation
2. First launch of Xuanjie O3! Lu Weibing responds to Xiaomi 18 Fold pricing: Starting above ten thousand yuan, definitely better value than Apple
3. Second largest in Asia this year! ByteDance to obtain approximately USD 29.6 billion syndicated loan
4. Can users with over 10,000 friends check one-way deletions? WeChat PR Director: Some relationships, clean them out to make room for what matters
5. Renren Video returns, app listed, existing users gifted 1 month membership
6. Baidu BMU brings in mysterious North American expert; former DeepSeek researcher appointed head of Ernie multimodal
7. Enflame Technology lottery numbers announced, issue price RMB 142.18/share
8. U.S. government plans new round of tariffs on imported chips to promote manufacturing reshoring

**Top Story**

OpenAI releases most powerful model ever, GPT-6 Astra: million-token context, autonomous computer operation

In the early hours of Friday Beijing time, OpenAI officially released GPT-6 Astra, calling it "the most intelligent and best-aligned model in the world," achieving state-of-the-art performance across computer operation, web browsing, software engineering, cybersecurity, scientific research, and professional work. The model features a context window of 1.05 million tokens, maximum output of 128,000 tokens, and a knowledge cutoff date of April 30, 2026.
